title: A catalog entry's update policy
description: updates/<id>.yaml in a catalog repository: how dockwell-catalog bump moves the entry's images to newer releases (ADR 0100). A server never reads it. Each field left out takes its default from code.

gives.description: The Compose service whose tag gives the entry's version. An entry of one image needs none; one of more gets no bumps until it's set.

services.description: Each service's policy, by its name in the entry's Compose file.

level.description: The largest step that merges by itself: patch (a database engine's image, and an app on 0.x or calendar versions, by default), minor (an app at 1.0 or later, by default), none (only a person moves it) or stays (it never moves). A major never merges by itself.

rebuilds.description: The repository pushes the same tag again by design, as Docker Official Images do, which is its default for them.

signedBy.description: Who signs the image: a cosign keyless issuer and subject, or a GitHub attestation's repository and workflow. A person confirms it once.

majorsInOrder.description: The app can't skip a major, as Nextcloud can't: its next major is offered only where it's the one right after.

hold.description: Versions to skip, each with why. Only a person's pull request changes it.

version.description: A version whole, such as 1.5.2, or its first parts: 1.5 holds 1.5.0 and every 1.5.x.
